description: Needs an API key (a free key works). The Hyperliquid liquidation alerts on this API key's account: where each posts (host only), its filter, whether it is active, failed deliveries in a row with the last error, liquidations sent so far, and how many alerts the tier allows. An alert is disabled after 20 failed deliveries in a row; test_liquidation_alert re-enables it once the destination works again.
name: list_liquidation_alerts

destination.description: Host it posts to, without the secret part of the URL

last_sent_at.description: Last delivery, RFC 3339; null before the first

markets.description: Markets watched; empty means every market

status.description: active or disabled (after 20 failed deliveries in a row)

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key

title: List liquidation alerts
